scope: Diagnostic full Go listing after the minimal sampler change, with complete wcprof, five-second CPU windows and aligned cumulative mutex/block/goroutine snapshots. This is wait attribution, not a latency benchmark. Normal telemetry, validation and GC; rejected prepared-schema and parallel-client-admission experiments stay off. Linear restored-posting removal is common with the preceding cohort.
allocation_profiles: Cumulative allocs before and after the diagnostic command, no forced GC. Profiles are sampled and may lag recent allocations until subsequent normal GC cycles.
